description: The file defines the SizeOption interface, which extends Option, representing a size-related option for a search or query operation, including methods to get the size and to get a string representation.

classes.name: SizeOption
classes.description: An interface for options specifying the size or number of results to retrieve, with methods to get the size and its string representation.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of results requested.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation in the format 'size(<number>)'.
